Name: Flowery Straw Hat
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Flowery Straw Hat[/u][/b]

[/size][size=3]Decorates the Straw Hat with a flower that changes (almost) everyday, depending on the season and day. The idea is to give "an early game" hat a little more reason to be worn (even more so for new players). [b]1.1.0[/b] Now has festival decorations on festival days, some even change depending on what year you're on.

[/size]Also in includes JA and FS versions for custom hats.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/LU4Hef0.gif[/img][/center][center][size=3]Table for the different hats:[/size]
[size=3][spoiler][/size][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/QAYaJjE.png[/img][/size][size=3][/spoiler][/size][/center]

[size=5][b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (For the CP version)
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] (For the JA version)
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] (for the FS version)[/size]
[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)[/size]

[size=5][u][b]Credits[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]Thanks to[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/80928528]Kdau[/url][b] [/b]for helping me with writing the content.json and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/108478153?tab=user+files]Kailey[/url] for the FS conversion![/size]

[size=5][b][u]Extra[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]I may add some more decorations in the future. Let me know what you think or if you got some ideas :)

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/LU4Hef0.gif[/img][/center][/size]
